subject: [hw] DONE DEC06 rev 5: FIXED full-range StartSession (OPEN must always ask MM21, not NV12); N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2533/2533
body:
DONE DEC06 rev 5. Supersedes rev 4. Host only: no phone, nothing published, no commit outside my owned files.

Last line:
  bash gpu/hwcodec/vt/dec/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST DEC06 PASS 2533/2533

The bug fixed here would have broken every full-range stream on the phone:
- n2vtd_obj.c open_session passed the daemon layout "NV12" when the SPS VUI said full range, conflating the CVPixelBuffer range (420f) with the daemon"s output layout. DEC05 only accepts MM21 (its n2vcd_dec_open rejects other out_format with E_UNSUPPORTED), so StartSession would have failed on every full-range stream - and VideoToolbox does NOT retry a StartSession error, so the VTDecompressionSessionCreate would have failed with no software fallback.
- Fix: always ask for MM21; 420v vs 420f is only the VTDecoderSessionSetPixelBufferAttributes pixel format (still chosen from the SPS VUI as before).
- Regression checks: the fake client records the OPEN layout/size; the object test now requires tfd_open_format == MM21 on both the limited-range and the full-range sessions, and tfd_open_max_w/h == the SPS display size (176x144). T_OBJ is 167 checks per build now; suite total 2533, all green in ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan, plus the DEC05 adapter compile, the arm64-ios16 dylib link and import audit.

Also since rev 4 (same session): clang --analyze is clean on all seven product sources; it caught two real defects during the final pass: an uninitialised used[] array in the HEVC short-term-RPS parser (now memset) and a 1<<64 shift on an empty NAL (now guarded); both fixed and covered.

Not done (unchanged): no phone run / no daemon end-to-end; MM21 order libyuv-verified but not phone-verified; crop origin always 0; 10-bit/non-4:2:0/interlaced refused per frame with no nested software-session fallback; in-band parameter-set changes not tracked; CPU-side copy; setProperties/copySerializableProperties reply -12782; emit under the session mutex.

Files since rev 4: vt/dec/n2vtd_obj.c (MM21 always), vt/dec/n2vtd_nal.c (two analyzer fixes), vt/dec/test/t_fakeclient_dec.{h,c} (OPEN inspection), vt/dec/test/t_obj.c (5 checks), vt/dec/STATUS.md, dsh-state/workers/DEC06/STATUS.md. All inside my owned directories.
